# Hack & Develop With Ai

> Unlimited AI API gateway: one key for 16 AI models with no token quota and no request cap. Plans from $50 a month, paid by UPI, card or QR code.

## What this site offers
- Unlimited tokens and unlimited requests on every subscription plan.
- 16 models: Claude Haiku 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Terra, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Argon, GPT-6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1.
- OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses; Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages.
- Base URL: https://freeai.jembatanai.com/v1
- Clients: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, OpenCode, Kilo Code.

## Plans
- Pro: $50/month (monthly only), 4 parallel sessions, 4 base models.
- Max: $75/month (monthly only), 8 parallel sessions, 12 models.
- Ultra: $23/day or $155/month, 14 parallel sessions, all 16 models.
- Token Plans and pay-per-use are also available.
